fields.description: Account the daily geo master sync (DA Country / Region / Zone / Woreda / Kebele) logs in with through SSO. Its access token and CSRF token are sent to Master Data.
fields.label: Master Data Sync

fields.description: Login key of the IAM service (the key of /sso/login), e.g. agent.
fields.label: Login Key

fields.description: Tab of the DA register that holds a DA's record with its education records and family members (the tab_id of register-data/get_tab_records), e.g. da_details_tab.
fields.label: DA Registry Tab ID

fields.description: Grievance APISIX gateway host only (e.g. https://grievance-service.development.oanstaging.com). Public paths are /v1/... rewritten to /api/v1/... . Do not use the Desk hostname and do not append /api.
fields.label: Grievance Base URL

fields.description: Staff-realm Keycloak client-credentials for the central dashboard Visit chart feeder. Leave Enabled unchecked for local / empty clientId.
fields.label: Charts Auth

fields.description: When checked, GET /charts/visits requires a staff-realm Bearer token with client role charts:read.
fields.label: Charts Auth Enabled

fields.description: Staff-realm issuer URL, e.g. https://keycloak.example/realms/staff. JWKS is {issuer}/protocol/openid-connect/certs.
fields.label: Charts Auth Issuer

fields.description: Charts API client id (JWT aud or azp), e.g. da-services-dashboard-api
fields.label: Charts Auth Audience

fields.description: Crop Sown staff host (e.g. staff-crop.development.oanstaging.com). Required.
fields.label: Crop Registry Domain

fields.description: CropSown register UUID (register_id). Required; no get_all_registers discovery.
fields.label: Crop Registry Form Register ID

fields.description: Livestock register UUID (register_id). Required; no get_all_registers discovery.
fields.label: Livestock Registry Form Register ID
